description: This file defines the WorkWeekIndexedModel class within the OrangeHRM Leave API module. The class models a week's work schedule intensively by mapping week day properties to their corresponding numerical indices, utilizing traits and interfaces for serialization and normalization in the API.

classes.name: WorkWeekIndexedModel
